title: Experience
subtitle: Senior frontend ownership across healthcare, fintech, travel booking, and SaaS

items.description: Joined to unify frontend quality across products that had grown separately. Now own architecture and delivery standards for **five production surfaces** — patient, clinician, and operations products at national scale.
achievements: Own frontend delivery across **5 production products** (patient app, consultation suite, operations console, physician workspace, shared design system). Align sprints with product and design so polish and technical risk move together

Migrated critical surfaces from **Pages Router** to **Next.js 15 App Router** with **Server Components**, **SSR**, **SSG**, metadata, and route-level splitting — converted **15 pages** to SSR, improved technical SEO, and cut initial load by about **40%**
Designed and published a shared **DDD-inspired TypeScript** package for business domains so product teams stopped reinventing booking and visit rules in UI code
Architected **Raasti Kit**, an npm-distributed **design system** with **Storybook**, design tokens, and bundle budgets — adopted by **5 teams**, reducing duplicate UI

Shipped **JWT**-authenticated, role-based health UI and realtime teleconsultation with **SignalR**; delivered physician analytics on **React 19** and **Vite**, with **Vitest**, **Husky**, and production monitoring ownership

items.location: Remote · Travel booking & private MVP products
items.description: Worked with early product teams that needed senior frontend judgment before hiring a permanent FE org. Focused on booking UX and foundations that would still hold after handover.
achievements: Built a **travel booking** experience across web and mobile with **React Native**, **Next.js**, and **TanStack Query** — search, listing, and checkout flows with **WCAG**-aligned forms
Diagnosed slow booking screens against **Lighthouse** budgets; introduced **code splitting**, lazy loading, and **SCSS** delivery standards that improved perceived performance on high-intent paths
For private MVP projects, set greenfield **Next.js 15 App Router** architecture: routing conventions, SSR strategy, **JWT** API integration, feature-based structure, and **shadcn/ui** standards
Standardized forms, client state, and realtime patterns (**React Hook Form**, **Zustand**, **Socket.IO**) across engagements, with architecture notes for handover

items.description: Spent more than two years on a high-traffic exchange where frontend mistakes show up as lost trust in live prices and orders. Grew from feature delivery into shared UI standards and performance ownership.
achievements: Shipped trading and account features in **React** and **TypeScript** with **JWT** sessions — flows that had to stay correct when market activity spiked
Built and hardened **Socket.IO** dashboards for order books, tickers, alerts, and notifications under peak throughput
Improved key-flow page load by about **25%** (analytics and Lighthouse) through rendering, bundle, and asset work
Drove adoption of a shared **shadcn/ui** and **Storybook** library that reduced duplicate components across teams
Debugged production UI with backend partners, improved error handling around auth and market-data gaps, and documented conventions that shortened onboarding

items.description: Started on marketing-facing pages and grew into CRM tooling and shared frontend structure — learning how SEO, design, and sales operations pull the same UI in different directions.
achievements: Built **SEO**-oriented landing pages and responsive **SCSS** component patterns for axon.me with marketing and SEO stakeholders
Delivered CRM tables, admin dashboards, and multi-step workflows that cut repetitive manual work for sales and operations
Introduced **Redux** for multi-page state predictability and **BEM** modular CSS so new UI shipped faster with fewer style regressions
Translated stakeholder requests into maintainable component work instead of one-off page edits
